key_catalyst: Mega-cap tech earnings week (Alphabet, Tesla, Intel) driving pre-market bid, set against escalating US-Iran conflict with Brent above $90
reasoning: The dominant positioning driver today is mega-cap earnings anticipation (Alphabet, Tesla, Intel this week), reinforced by the Meta-Anthropic $10B AI compute deal and a five-month high in consumer sentiment — all three sources rate the earnings setup as the top catalyst. The US-Iran escalation is real and worsening (9th night of strikes, Brent > $90, 30-year yield > 5%, ~60% September hike odds), but recent history shows this theme has acted as an amplifier rather than a primary driver: on 2026-07-14 QQQ rose +1.12% with oil above $86 when bullish tech/macro catalysts dominated, while the down days (07-15, 07-16) were triggered by company-specific shocks (IBM, TSMC) plus rates, not geopolitics alone. With reports not landing until Wednesday/Thursday and the market currently looking through the oil spike, there is insufficient conviction to sell today despite the elevated macro risk.
